verdict.rationale: Secureframe offers an API for working with any object in the account and for pushing raw data into the platform. Its official MCP server docs also describe a mode for setups with no browser, explicitly naming CI jobs and scripts, so headless, automated use is supported. Missing for 10: detailed API/auth documentation for non-interactive tokens (the CI snippet is truncated), any CLI or ready-made CI integration, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
